name: AI Trading Company — Full-Scale Enterprise Trading Platform

rationale: Blueprint self-classifies as 'Full-Scale Enterprise Release', explicitly NOT MVP/prototype/pilot (docs/25 §1).
26 authoritative specifications (docs/MANIFEST.json), 8 implementation phases (docs/13), 12 binary gates G0-G11 (docs/11).
4-language polyglot build: Go authoritative control plane, TypeScript/Next.js operator UI, Python research, Rust by ADR only (docs/02, docs/25 §4).
13 bounded contexts and 9 control-plane modules with one-way authority flow (docs/01 §2, §7).
Regulated financial domain: live trading with money movement, immutable ledger, dual-control approvals, legal/jurisdiction eligibility gates (docs/18, docs/23, docs/25 §3.7).
Repo contained ZERO executable code at baseline_commit 15d978f, which is when this rating was assigned; all 8 phases were unstarted then. See current_state for the counts as of 7733977.

source_of_truth.g0_mechanical_method: SHA-256 + byte-length recompute of all 26 manifest documents
source_of_truth.g0_caveat: G0.1 through G0.7 are mechanically PASS. G0.8 is REQUIRES_HUMAN_ATTESTATION and no named human reviewer has signed the package, so the gate is NOT passed. This field is not a claim that G0 passed, and it must not be read as one.

product_boundary.description: AI-native proprietary trading platform across crypto, FX, equities, commodities.
product_boundary.authority_rule: AI may propose. Deterministic controls decide. The OMS records the authoritative order state. Reconciliation resolves external truth. The ledger records financial facts.
product_boundary.live_default: DISABLED — deny-by-default until G0-G11 pass with evidence (docs/25 §3.7, docs/11 G11)

technology_baseline.operator_ui: TypeScript / React / Next.js App Router — presentation only
technology_baseline.event_delivery: PostgreSQL transactional outbox; NATS JetStream at defined threshold
technology_baseline.cache: Redis 8 — ephemeral only, never financial truth

detected_toolchain.docker_daemon: NOT RUNNING (docker info failed: dockerDesktopLinuxEngine pipe not found)
detected_toolchain.note: PostgreSQL 17 is required and is expected to be provided via Docker. Docker daemon must be started before any persistence work.

executable_code_breakdown.note: executable_code_at_head counts go, python and typescript/javascript sources only. SQL migrations are counted separately and are not included in it.

deleted_code_history.conformity: NON-CONFORMANT with the authoritative blueprint: a Python authoritative backend violates ADR-001 (Go is the authoritative control plane) and ADR-003 (Python restricted to research/backtest). Not a restore target; may be mined for domain/naming reference only.

plan.approved_scope: Greenfield Go implementation of the canonical repository shape; Phases 1-7 to G0-G10; G11 out of scope; G0+G1 as the first delivery boundary.
plan.summary: Execute docs/13 Phases 1-7 to reach G0-G10. Phase 8 (G11 live activation) is out of engineering scope and remains deny-by-default.
plan.first_delivery_boundary: G0 + G1 (Phases 1-2: foundation and domain core)

team.model: single-owner serial execution with bounded delegation
team.rationale: Zero code exists and authority boundaries are strict. The critical path is a single Go control plane. Parallelism would create overlapping write scopes in /services/control-plane. Delegation is reserved for read-only review passes.

out_of_scope: Live trading activation (G11) — requires two distinct authorized approvers, verified legal eligibility, and provisioned isolated live credentials
Real venue/broker connectivity with production credentials
Terraform-managed production cloud infrastructure (tool not installed)
Certified regulatory/legal approval for any jurisdiction
secrets_policy: No secret may be written into any Project Brain artifact or into the repository. Credentials live in external secret storage only.
